.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/task/solution/app/src/custom-editor.js, src/runtime.ts, public/assets/index.js (grep for probe literals and static messages)
evidence:
Static review of the frozen bytes; no runtime run was needed for or performed by this row. (1) Seed: task/environment/assets/seed_data.json is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed..."}; there is no seeded record a probe could match. (2) Reference initial state: solution/solve.sh removes app.db, app.db-wal and app.db-shm before copying the app, and server.js only creates tables (the single INSERT OR IGNORE at server.js:167 back-fills revisions from existing snippets, of which there are none), so the library starts empty. app.tsx:22-39 starts with code '', title 'Untitled', filename 'snippet.js', record null, snippets [], console entries [], status 'Ready', conflict null; the newer-revision notice (app.tsx:155), the conflict notice (:154) and the history section (:160) render only after the corresponding event. public/runner.html holds no visible text. (3) Probe literals: nearly every probe is chosen by the judge at grading time ('a distinctive marker', 'a unique title', 'unique start, middle and tail markers'; functional prompt.md: 'You may choose the exact fixture text for each criterion. Check that the editor holds it before acting.'), and app_context.md says 'Do not assume an empty library'. The only fixed literal the criteria dictate is in cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic ('Type the three characters MUL ... then type the two characters TI ... so MULTI is typed'): a case-sensitive grep for MULTI finds 0 hits in seed_data.json, solution/app/src, server.js, the HTML files and the built public/assets/index.js and index.css (the only case-insensitive hit in src is the attribute aria-multiline at custom-editor.js:23, which is not source text). (4) Negative outcomes are not satisfied by an untouched app: cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft requires a baseline ('confirm that A shows no notice about a newer revision yet'), cw_unsaved_marker starts from 'no unsaved-changes indication may be shown' and then requires it to appear, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes, cw_dynamic_code_refused, cw_format_error_keeps_draft and cw_preview_isolation each demand a working control first, and the dynamic-code payload marker is built 'by joining two halves, so the whole marker never appears in the source text', so the draft itself cannot pre-satisfy or falsely trip the marker check. Notes (not defects): (a) The reference shows permanent text that is not a probe value: footer '... Escape, then Tab Leave editor · 5s run budget' (app.tsx:173) and the New template 'document.body.innerHTML = "

Hello, Colderwater

";\nconsole.log("Ready to explore.");' (app.tsx:99). The footer phrase is static help, not a per-run reason; the reference's real reason is 'Execution stopped: five-second time limit' (runtime.ts:141, :376) shown in the status. A careless judge could in principle read '5s run budget' as a time-limit reason on an app that copied that footer, but that concerns criterion precision rather than a probe present in seed or reference state. (b) After New the reference editor holds that two-line template rather than an empty draft, so criteria that start with New (cw_save_reload_restart) rely on the judge replacing it; the prompt's 'Check that the editor holds it before acting' covers this. (c) Records accumulate across criteria and dimensions; uniqueness is delegated to the judge ('unique title'), there is no fixed title that could collide. (d) Evidence index: none of the artifacts it lists could be hash-verified. At review time qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/ contained only results/build.log and results/restart.log; run_golden.sh, tests/*.cjs, results/*.json, the PNGs and the cited run-outputs/.../result.json paths were not found (find and git ls-files both empty). This does not change this row's verdict, which rests on the frozen source, but the owner should restore or re-point those artifacts.
